hook: Border checks caused a two-month diplomatic dispute between Italy and Spain.

sections.voiceover: Border checks caused a two-month diplomatic dispute between Italy and Spain.
b_roll: Map showing Italy and Spain highlighted

sections.voiceover: In the summer of 2026, a migration crisis hit the Spanish territory of Ceuta. How will Italy and Spain resolve their 2-month diplomatic dispute over border checks?
b_roll: Map of Europe with Schengen area highlighted

sections.voiceover: Pedro Sánchez and Giorgia Meloni had to act fast, because the diplomatic rift kept growing.
b_roll: Split screen of Meloni and Sánchez

sections.voiceover: Interior ministers will meet next week to officially lift the border checks. This new agreement will officially lift the 2-month suspension of Schengen travel rules between both nations.
b_roll: Chart showing 2 month timeline dropping to 0

sections.voiceover: The Schengen Agreement will finally resume across these two nations.
